test_item: 负向 - postcode 为空字符串
title: postcode 传空字符串时 success 返回 false
steps:
1. POST /address/validate
2. Body: postcode 传空字符串 ""
3. 查看响应
expected_result: HTTP 200；data.success=false（postcode 为空无法在数据库匹配）；系统不崩溃
validation_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM lsp_dev.lsp_address_suburb_postcode WHERE postcode='' AND country_code='AU' AND state_code='NSW';
